import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Stop and clear pm2 cache
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 stop areloria 2>&1")
print("Stopped:", stdout.read().decode())

# Delete tsx cache
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm -rf /opt/areloria/node_modules/.cache /opt/areloria/server/node_modules/.cache 2>&1 || true")
print("Cache cleared")

# Restart fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1")
print("\nRestarted:", stdout.read().decode())

import time
time.sleep(8)

# Check logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 15 --nostream 2>&1 | tail -15")
print("\nLogs:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
